Maya Chen: Quick qtr OKR check — can teams drop a one-line shipped vs slipped update for milestone M-3. Include owner, ETA if slipped, and any deps we should escalate. I'll compile notes.
Noah Patel: Runtime — shipped model routing improvements to canary yesterday. Owner: Noah. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/412. Perf looks good. :shipit:
Lee Costa: Eng-infra slipped: autoscale tuning for Dedicated pools — regression on burst reclaim. Owner: Lee. New ETA: Fri EOD (+2). Need SRE to sign off on rollback plan.
Tina Morales: SRE will review rollback plan today. @Lee can you drop the runbook link?
Lee Costa: runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/infra/autoscale-rollbacks — TL;DR: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/dedicated-pool --to-revision=3`
Sven-bot: deploy status — canary rollout 2/5 nodes healthy — monitoring alerts silenced for 5m per Noah.
Olivia Park: Product — shipped UX flows for model version pinning. Owner: Olivia. Found edge-case with saved configs; patch queued. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/98
Raj Singh: Dependency: console patch needs a minor API change in routing service (Noah). ETA for API change?
Noah Patel: I can carve 2 dev days tomorrow, ETA Wed EOD. Will post PR link when ready.
Tina Morales: Also FYI — Dedicated capacity soak test starts Thurs 09:00 PT. Please avoid schema changes during that window.
Maya Chen: Can we capture owners/ETAs in a mini table so I can paste to the OKR doc? I'll handle escalation on Friday if anything slips.
Noah Patel: Owner: Noah | task: routing API | ETA: Wed EOD | PR: https://github.com/redwood/routing/pull/204
Lee Costa: Owner: Lee | task: autoscale tuning rollback + test | ETA: Fri EOD | blocking: infra quota increase from cloud team
Tina Morales: SRE owner: Tina | task: test window + rollback signoff | ETA: Thurs end
Olivia Park: Owner: Olivia | task: console saved-configs fix | ETA: Thu noon | CR: @Raj please review when ready
Raj Singh: I can review Thu afternoon. Ping me when CI is green.
Maya Chen: Two asks: 1) If you need escalation to Cloud Eng for quota, call it out here. 2) If you need CR reviewers, drop PR link + reviewer. I'll escalate any misses at Friday sync.
Noah Patel: Potential escalation: may need temporary GPU quota bump for canary perf testing — tagging @cloud-team to confirm capacity.
Tina Morales: @cloud-team can we get a temporary +50 GPUs in us-west for Thurs-Fri tests?
Cloud-ops: Confirmed, submitting request now. ETA ~4h for approval. Will DM updates.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — compiling this into the OKR doc now. I'll post the snippet + owners page once done. :memo:
